fct_github_day_surprise.content:
name: fct_github_day_surprise
description: 'Metric 4 backup: each counted day against the weekday-and-trend prediction from the days before it. One row per activity per day up to release day with a same-weekday day before it; release day is one row, the rest are placebos. Population: Every counted day up to release day with at least one earlier day on the same weekday (the first week cannot be predicted); days after release day and days without a count are not candidates.'
model: ref('fct_github_day_surprise')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: candidate_date
dimensions:
  - name: activity
    type: categorical
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: candidate_date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: The day scored.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: is_release_day
    type: categorical
    description: True on GTA 6's release day; every other row is a placebo.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: fit_days
    agg: max
    expr: fit_days
    description: Counted days before the candidate the model was fitted on.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: days
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: df
    agg: max
    expr: df
    description: 'Degrees of freedom: fit days - weekdays - 1.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: daily_trend
    agg: max
    expr: daily_trend
    description: Fitted trend, log points per day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: log points per day
          null_rule: NULL while every weekday has a single day (no trend yet).
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: expected_count
    agg: max
    expr: expected_count
    description: What the days before predict for the candidate.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL while there is no trend yet.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: observed_count
    agg: max
    expr: observed_count
    description: The candidate's count.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: pct_vs_expected
    agg: max
    expr: pct_vs_expected
    description: Observed against expected, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL while there is no trend yet.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: t_stat
    agg: max
    expr: t_stat
    description: Gap in prediction standard errors. NULL with under the minimum history.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: standard errors
          null_rule: NULL under the minimum history or df < 5.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: Every counted day up to release day with at least one earlier day on the same weekday (the first week cannot be predicted); days after release day and days without a count are not candidates.
      assumptions:
        - decision: What 'normal' release day would have been
          chosen: log(count) = weekday level + linear trend, fitted on every counted day before the candidate; one-sided t on the prediction error
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user, 20 Nov: a formal hypothesis test that the drop is significant; the model was fixed before the result was computed: weekday levels for the weekly cycle, a trend for GitHub''s growth, logs so changes are relative'
          column: t_stat
        - decision: Placebos
          chosen: the same test on every earlier day with >= 21 days of history
          evidence: default
          detail: 'an empirical check that does not lean on the t distribution: how often an ordinary day lands this far below its prediction'
          column: is_release_day
        - decision: Which days are candidates
          chosen: counted days up to release day with an earlier same-weekday day; the first week, later days and uncounted days are left out
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user, 20 Nov: test 19 Nov against what came before it; a day with nothing before it cannot be predicted, and a day after release is not a placebo'
          column: candidate_date

notes: candidate_date: its type could not be read, so it is given day granularity, which a date or a timestamp both support
not derived (role key or attribute, which a semantic model has no element for): github_surprise_key
metrics are not derived: a measure is what a column holds, a metric is a business definition, and that stays the author's

fct_github_release_day_test.content:
name: fct_github_release_day_test
description: 'Metric 4 backup: the release-day hypothesis test, one row per activity. Population: One row per activity with a release-day row in fct_github_day_surprise.'
model: ref('fct_github_release_day_test')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: release_day
entities:
  - name: activity
    type: primary
    expr: activity
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
dimensions:
  - name: release_day
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: fit_days
    agg: max
    expr: fit_days
    description: Days the release-day prediction was fitted on.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: days
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: df
    agg: max
    expr: df
    description: Degrees of freedom of the primary test.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: expected_count
    agg: max
    expr: expected_count
    description: Release day as predicted from the days before it.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: observed_count
    agg: max
    expr: observed_count
    description: Release day as counted.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: pct_vs_expected
    agg: max
    expr: pct_vs_expected
    description: Observed against expected, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: t_stat
    agg: max
    expr: t_stat
    description: Primary test statistic (Student t, df above).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: standard errors
          null_rule: NULL under the minimum history.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: placebo_days
    agg: max
    expr: placebo_days
    description: Earlier days scored the same way.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: placebo_days_as_low
    agg: max
    expr: placebo_days_as_low
    description: Placebo days with a t at or below release day's.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: placebo_p
    agg: max
    expr: placebo_p
    description: '(as low + 1) / (placebo days + 1): the share of days, release day included, this far below their prediction.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: fraction
          null_rule: NULL without a release-day t.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_n
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_n
    description: Earlier same-weekday week-on-week changes.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_wow_mean
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_wow_mean
    description: Their mean, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL without earlier changes.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_wow_sd
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_wow_sd
    description: Their standard deviation, in percent points.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL with fewer than two.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: release_wow
    agg: max
    expr: release_wow
    description: Release day's week-on-week change, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL when either day is missing.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_t
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_t
    description: Release day's change against the earlier ones, in prediction SDs.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: standard errors
          null_rule: NULL with fewer than 3 earlier changes.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: weekday_df
    agg: max
    expr: weekday_df
    description: weekday_n - 1.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL without earlier changes.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: One row per activity with a release-day row in fct_github_day_surprise.
        parent:
          model: fct_github_release_day_activities
          key:
            activity: activity
      assumptions:
        - decision: Placebo p-value
          chosen: (placebo days at or below release day's t + 1) / (placebo days + 1)
          evidence: default
          detail: the standard rank p-value that counts release day itself, so it is never zero
          column: placebo_p
        - decision: Thursday check
          chosen: release day's week-on-week change against the earlier same-weekday changes, prediction t with n - 1 df
          evidence: default
          detail: uses only the Thursdays, with no model of the trend
          column: weekday_t
